acceptance_defined: 2026-11-04 before PyCy candidate implementation or numerical comparison; official Live Script physical parameter set
known_difference: Same third pure electrical T-equivalent network of the original five-network CompareCircuits model, using the official Live Script parameter set (step at 2s, Rc=1e5 inverse henry). Same ideal ratio and three separate lossless inductors, zero initial currents; magnetizing branch is after primary leakage. Reference solver is independently refined. Linear DC-step experiment does not certify physical DC transformer operation, saturation, hysteresis, or the different aggregate model of existing example 09. No fitted time/phase/amplitude alignment.

internal_acceptance.independent_solution: Two-state coupled equation [[.11,-.5],[-.5,2.75]]*d[i_source,i_load]/dt + diag(1,1)*[i_source,i_load] = [u,0], exact step response via matrix exponential; i_magnetizing=i_source-i_load/.2
internal_acceptance.reference_self_refinement: 1ms/0.5ms native maximum-step runs, ode15s RelTol1e-9 AbsTol1e-11; union-time differences in both frozen windows below one tenth of each signal absolute limit
required_checks: all three initial inductor currents zero
inductor currents continuous through the explicit source event
ideal voltage ratio and zero transformer power loss
positive winding-external resistor losses and stored energy
energy plus losses versus source work with explicit event sides
finite 8s response versus exact solution; DC limit is a separate asymptotic check
